changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionUser') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [api].[ExecutionUser]( [ExecutionID] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [ItemNumber] [int] NOT NULL, [ExecutionItemUid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, Username nvarchar(500) null, [Uid] uniqueidentifier, ResourceID int, FirstName nvarchar(500), LastName nvarchar(500), [State] int, IsAdministrator bit not null, IsNew bit not null, Success bit null, Message nvarchar(max), [Object] varchar(50), ObjectID int not null, ObjectType varchar(50), ObjectTypeID int not null CONSTRAINT [PK_ApiExecutionUser] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [ExecutionID] ASC, [ItemNumber] ASC )WITH (STATISTICS_NORECOMPUTE = OFF, IGNORE_DUP_KEY = OFF) ON [PRIMARY] ) ON [PRIMARY] END
IF EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'PK_ApiExecutionUser' and type_desc = 'CLUSTERED') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [api].[ExecutionUser] drop CONSTRAINT [PK_ApiExecutionUser]
ALTER TABLE [api].[ExecutionUser] ADD CONSTRAINT [PK_ApiExecutionUser] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [ExecutionID] ASC, [ItemNumber] ASC )WITH (STATISTICS_NORECOMPUTE = OFF, IGNORE_DUP_KEY = OFF, ONLINE = OFF) ON [PRIMARY]
END
